style_plan: hook=実写AI動画（霜の朝の畑・ぬかるみで長靴の足元がずるっと滑る）＋大きな文字を叩きつけ
three=暗いスタジオに実写の切り抜き → 赤い面に大きな「3つ」 → 一語畳み掛け（rush：つま先・かかと・サイズ／霜と稲の実写写真） → 生成り紙に切り抜きの真横＋①②③の札
toe=赤い面の番号札「1」 → クレヨン手描きの長靴断面（すき間・ずるっ） → 暗いスタジオで切り抜きのつま先に寄る＋数え上げ約7mm → クレヨンでインソールが入りすき間が埋まる → ぬかるみの実写写真（coverImg）
heel=赤い面の番号札「2」 → 設計図の線画（浅いとかかとが浮く → 深型ヒールカップが立ち上がる） → 暗いスタジオに切り抜きの真横＋かかと・土踏まずへ赤い引き出し線＋数え上げ約8mm → 生成り紙に商品写真の白フチカード
size=赤い面の番号札「3」 → 生成り紙のフラット図解（S・M・Lのシルエット） → 暗いスタジオにサイズ札3枚（cm） → 生成り紙の上面図にカットライン＋はさみ → クラフト紙に商品写真の白フチカード
end=AI背景（霜の朝の畑の板の上）＋実物のインソール・パッケージ＋①②③の札＋実物ロゴ

video.prompt:
[SCENE] Late-autumn early morning in a Japanese vegetable field: rows of daikon radish and napa cabbage, dark wet soil with thin white frost on the clods along the furrow edges. Ankle-height close shot from the side: a farmer wearing plain matte black knee-high rubber boots walks down a gentle muddy slope between two rows. Within the first two seconds, the front boot lands on slick mud and skids forward a few centimeters before catching, smearing mud ahead of the toe; then the back boot lifts out of the soft mud with a slight suction and steps forward. Steady, natural walking, no falling.
[CAMERA] Vertical 9:16 framing. Low, stable side tracking shot at boot height, 35mm lens, aperture f/5.6 so the furrows and leaves behind stay clearly readable (no heavy background blur), focus on the boots. Real-time speed, no slow-motion.
[LIGHTING] Low cold morning sun from camera-right, 4800K, long thin shadows, soft blue shade on the frost, specular glints on wet mud and rubber.
[MATERIALS & TEXTURE] Glossy wet black rubber, sticky dark brown mud with boot-shaped smears, crunchy frost crystals on soil clods, waxy green daikon leaves.
[COLOR PALETTE] Charcoal black, deep earth brown, frost white with pale blue shade, muted leaf green, one warm amber sun accent. Natural contrast.
[AUDIO] Natural sounds only: squelch and slide of boots in mud, faint crunch of frosty soil, distant morning birds. No music, no voice.
[AVOID] Logos, text, letters or brand marks on the boots, product packaging, insoles, people's faces, extra legs, deformed feet, morphing boots, falling down, camera shake, fisheye distortion, heavy bokeh, slow-motion.

images.prompt:
[SCENE] A Japanese vegetable field on a frosty late-autumn morning, vertical frame. In the lower third, a weathered flat wooden board lies on the dark soil at the end of a furrow, empty and clean, as a natural stage in the foreground. Behind it, rows of daikon radish and napa cabbage with thin white frost on the leaf edges and soil clods, a simple wooden fence and distant low hills. Upper third: calm, tonally uniform pale morning sky within the natural scene.
[LIGHTING] Low morning sun from camera-left, 4500K, gentle golden rim light on the frost, soft long shadows, faint morning mist.
[LENS & CAMERA] Shot on 35mm, aperture f/8, the board in sharp focus and the background clearly readable with only mild depth falloff.
[MATERIALS & TEXTURE] Raw grey-brown wood grain with a few frost crystals, damp dark soil, crisp white frost, waxy green leaves.
[COLOR PALETTE] Deep charcoal shadows, frost white with pale blue shade, muted leaf green, warm amber sunlight, one natural deep red accent from a few red autumn leaves on the soil.
[AVOID] Text, letters, logos, watermarks, people, animals, boots, products on the board, oversaturated sky, heavy blur, tilted horizon.
resolution: 2k
